statements.t: The Company expects to see continued volatility in the economic markets resulting from governmental responses to inflation, as well as uncertainty about the impacts of the conflict in Iran and tariffs.
The Company expects that growth to be profitable.
Assuming a change in long-term interest rates, the Company would anticipate that the unique features of its loan products will continue to attract customers in the residential mortgage loan area.
Ongoing portfolio management is intended to result in early identification and disengagement from deteriorating credits.

Also as of September 30, 2026, there were no other loans classified for regulatory purposes that management reasonably expects will materially impact future operating results, liquidity, or capital resources.
The Company also continues to apply a reasonable and supportable forecast based on Moody’s Baseline Scenario for a four-quarter period.
The Company actively manages its liquidity through target ratios established under its liquidity policies.

The Company uses an industry standard external model as the primary tool to identify, quantify and project changes in interest rates and their effect on loan prepayment speeds taken both from industry sources and internally generated data based upon historical trends in the Bank’s balance sheet.
